Use this template to create links to pages on other wikis. Be sure to double-check your spelling, because these will never show as redlinks, even if misspelled.

{| class="wikitable"
| Code
| Result
|-
| <nowiki>{{Wlink}}</nowiki>
|         {{Wlink}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{Wlink|lotr}}</nowiki>
|         {{Wlink|lotr}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{Wlink|lotr|Gandalf}}</nowiki>
|         {{Wlink|lotr|Gandalf}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{Wlink|lotr|Gandalf|Mithrandir}}</nowiki>
|         {{Wlink|lotr|Gandalf|Mithrandir}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{Wlink|lotr||Lord of the Rings}}</nowiki>
|         {{Wlink|lotr||Lord of the Rings}}
|-
|}
